labeling_notes: Manually reviewed labels: the minimal set of files a developer would need to read or edit to complete each task correctly. Labels were written from the sample repository's code before ranking weights were tuned. Paths are repository-relative.

tasks.task: Add JWT authentication to the FastAPI application and create tests for protected routes.
tasks.rationale: Token issuing/verification lives in AuthService and security helpers; the secret and TTL live in config; get_current_user guards the protected order/user routes; TokenResponse is in schemas; fixtures and auth/order tests must change.

tasks.task: Fix database retry behavior and add regression tests.
tasks.rationale: Database.connect delegates to retry_with_backoff (the bug), retry limits come from config, exhausted retries map to DatabaseUnavailableError; both test modules cover the behaviour.
Protected routes depend on get_current_user, which resolves tokens via AuthService; conftest provides auth_headers; test_orders is the existing protected-route test module.

tasks.task: Improve API error handling so that all errors, including validation errors, return consistent JSON error responses.
tasks.rationale: Handlers are defined in core/errors.py and registered in main.create_app; existing tests assert on error bodies and status codes.

tasks.task: Add request validation for order quantity and product id in the orders API.
tasks.rationale: OrderCreate lacks validators; the orders route and OrderService/OrderRepository handle product lookups; test_orders and its fixtures need new cases.
